- Initial release of Commute Time Optimizer.
- Calculates rush-hour travel times by weekday for any commute mode (car, transit, bike, walk, WFH).
- Computes true annual cost and time of commuting in hours and dollars, including driving, transit fares, and mode comparisons.
- Optimizes hybrid office-day schedules to minimize time spent in traffic.
- Supports multi-year cost and lifespan analysis for housing and job decisions, including equivalent rent calculations.
- Provides detailed command-line interface for customizable scenario analysis.
